points.name: apps.calendar.detail.title
points.interpretation: The refresh builder displays the event title or a localized fallback when empty.

points.name: apps.calendar.detail.location
points.interpretation: The refresh builder displays the event location only when nonempty.

points.name: apps.calendar.detail.description
points.interpretation: The refresh builder displays the event description only when nonempty.

points.name: apps.calendar.detail.location_icon
points.interpretation: The builder sets the location icon when a location exists.

points.name: apps.calendar.detail.description_icon
points.interpretation: The builder sets the description icon when a description exists.

points.name: apps.weather.forecast.day_icon
points.interpretation: The forecast loop assigns weather icon sources, with a separate unavailable-data fallback; each call can run for multiple days.

points.name: apps.weather.reminder.icon
points.interpretation: The reminder sets a failure icon and may replace it with a Bluetooth-disconnected icon.

points.name: apps.weather.reminder.retry_text
points.interpretation: The reminder sets conn_retry.common on a secondary label.

points.name: apps.weather.reminder.disconnected_text
points.interpretation: The reminder selects app-disconnected or Bluetooth-disconnected text based on connection state.

points.name: apps.weather.reminder.connected_text
points.interpretation: The reminder displays tipapp.weather when both observed connection checks are true.

points.name: apps.weather.reminder.button_register
points.interpretation: Registers callback 0x0c60fbf9 with event filter 7; the callback logs cancellation and requests navigation.

evidence: The calendar and weather manifests register the corresponding descriptors. Each page stores a root or allocated view state and clears the same slot on destroy. Calendar detail refresh uses its event record for title, location and description. Weather forecast renders an icon per daily row and uses a fallback when data is unavailable. Weather reminder branches on connection checks and registers a button callback.
scope: Only recorded calls on these pages. Date/time, schedule storage, weather retrieval, connection state and other ways to dismiss pages are outside this scope.
limitations: Calendar content may be private. Loop call sites affect multiple days. Image sources must remain valid while used. State slots do not provide thread synchronization; shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
